conversionRecipe: scripts/m4/export-sam2.py: pinned Microsoft wrappers, PyTorch 2.5.1 opset17, batch1, dynamic point count. Weight initializers stored FP16 and explicitly cast back to FP32; graph computations and IO remain FP32. ORT graphOptimizationLevel disabled.
artifactStatus: Final four-token artifacts verified in actual packaged macOS Tauri app and request-denied production worker; Windows/Linux untested
input: Encoder float32 normalized RGB [1,3,1024,1024], square resize per official image predictor. Decoder projected high-resolution features plus image embedding; float32 points in 1024 coordinates and int32 labels 1 positive/0 negative/2 top-left/3 bottom-right/-1 padding; optional low-res input mask disabled initially.
output: Four 256x256 float32 mask logits and predicted IoUs. Single click selects highest-IoU token 1..3, ties first. Box or multiple points use token0 with official stability fallback (delta0.05, threshold0.98) to best token1..3. Resize logits then sigmoid to coverage8, constrained by source alpha.
